definition: Estimated total replica DATA completed reads divided by estimated total primary DATA completed reads. Primary uses VACUUM-window average DATA read IOPS × VACUUM duration. Replica uses VACUUM-start through verified full catch-up average DATA read IOPS × the full elapsed duration; replay overlaps the VACUUM interval and its later tail.

replica.window: VACUUM start through verified full replica catch-up

source: root-independent-counter-audit.json; independently recomputed from raw OS device-counter deltas and timestamp overlaps

units.operations: estimated completed guest DATA read operations
